title.value: AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing
title.justification: The title is clearly stated as "AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing" in the provided text.
title.quote: AmbieGen: A Search-based Framework for Autonomous Systems Testing

extractions.description: The paper introduces AmbieGen, a search-based framework for generating test scenarios for autonomous systems like self-driving cars and robots. It uses evolutionary search to create critical test scenarios efficiently. AmbieGen supports the creation of test scenarios for lane-keeping assist systems and autonomous robots, focusing on robust testing in anticipation of real-world deployments.
